author: Ariadne I
title: FourierMixFLoad-LN-GFreq (k=320,p=32,M=16,H=96, γ_end=0.99) + Curvature
abstract: Global Frequency Bank variant: global per-factor harmonic frequencies/phases (w[k,m], phi[k,m]) with per-sample amplitudes A[b,k,m], LayerNorm in factor space, optional temporal envelope, gamma horizon gating, and residual copy. Train with MAE+curvature (λ=1e-4), Adam, Clip=1.0.
